shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json && git status --short && find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- src/main.tsx package.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/cpu-chart-browser/libs && cd /tmp/cpu-chart-browser/libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libwayland-server0 libexpat1 && for deb in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" .; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/cpu-chart-browser/libs && apt-get download libxrender1 libxi6 && for deb in libxrender*.deb libxi6*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" .; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/cpu-chart-browser/libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core && for deb in libsqlite*.deb fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" .; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'theme|className' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/tooltip.js | head -45 && rg -n 'theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js | head -35 && curl -s http://localhost:5173/src/CpuChart.tsx | head -18"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/cpu-chart-browser/lifecycle.mjs'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"' + file + '\", \"' + file.replaceAll('.', '\\\\\\\\.') + '\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/cpu-chart-browser/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/cpu-chart-browser/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/cpu-chart-browser/fonts.conf node /tmp/cpu-chart-browser/lifecycle.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm test && npm run build && git diff --check'
